title: Tiny, cute drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum body -->
  <rect x="28" y="38" width="44" height="34" rx="6" fill="#e8463c"/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <rect x="28" y="38" width="10" height="34" rx="5" fill="#c93a31"/>
  <rect x="62" y="38" width="10" height="34" rx="5" fill="#f0685e"/>
  <!-- drum top head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="24" ry="9" fill="#fdf3d8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="18" ry="6" fill="#f7e6b8"/>
  <!-- drum bottom head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="9" fill="#fdf3d8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="18" ry="6" fill="#f7e6b8"/>
  <!-- side rim highlights -->
  <rect x="24" y="40" width="5" height="30" rx="2.5" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <rect x="71" y="40" width="5" height="30" rx="2.5" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <!-- rim rings -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="40" rx="24" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#5cc8ff" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="24" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#5cc8ff" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- tension lugs -->
  <rect x="34" y="48" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <rect x="48" y="48" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <rect x="62" y="48" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <rect x="34" y="56" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <rect x="48" y="56" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <rect x="62" y="56" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <!-- cute face on drum body -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="52" r="3.2" fill="#3b2b64"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="52" r="3.2" fill="#3b2b64"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="51" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="51" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <path d="M45 60 Q50 65 55 60" fill="none" stroke="#3b2b64" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="57" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#ff9aa0"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="57" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#ff9aa0"/>
  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <line x1="16" y1="18" x2="40" y2="42" stroke="#d29a55" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <line x1="84" y1="18" x2="60" y2="42" stroke="#d29a55" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="#ffd45c"/>
  <!-- shine dots -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="44" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="64" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
